explication: Token Monitor is a local-first desktop dashboard for AI coding-tool usage, account limits, session details, and historical breakdowns, with optional cross-device sync. The principal flow is local tool data and provider accounts → collection and aggregation → dashboard, tray, or widget; sync can carry device statistics to a hub and return aggregated stats. The tree and README establish these capabilities, but sampled excerpts do not show the full collector or Electron startup wiring, so uncertain internal call links are omitted.
